site_brief.title: Super for creators and coaches turning conversations into content and operations

summary: A conversion‑focused niche landing page for creators and coaches who want to turn calls, DMs, and meetings into durable content and repeatable operations. Positions Super as the sharper alternative to chat‑first AI tools by emphasizing real computer use and a reusable computer‑use cache, grounded in current market evidence around agentic AI and workflow automation.
